notes.title: SCP Strategy is available now!
notes.content:
[h2]SCP Strategy is now available on Steam![/h2]

We are so glad you are about to play the result of many months of development work, sleepless nights, and time spent in the Early Access. But this is not the end. Be aware that the game still will be getting updated with new content like new SCP objects, special events, and much more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/b9e248c8ca88040aa44d3b3f7163f2ff7904a80f.png[/img]

SCP Strategy gives you an opportunity to manage your own SCP organization. You can catch SCPs, make research, improve your MTFs and your organization! 

Your mission is to make the world a safer place! You can focus on research on every single SCP or catch all of them and then start research. It is all your choice!

[previewyoutube=5CZbjZdEwxE;full][/previewyoutube]
Will your decisions rescue the world? We will see…

Good luck & have fun!
[b]LUXO Interactive team[/b]

notes.title: LUXO INTERACTIVE STATEMENT
notes.content:
[h2][b]We stand with Ukraine[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/fa5c8fb77737a774448922484f4b96402e4e116a.png[/img]

[quote]A few days ago our friends from Ukraine, our neighbors were attacked by Russia.

War is wreaking havoc and innocent people are dying. We have no words to describe this difficult situation.

Our thoughts and prayers are with Ukraine. Stay strong!

[b]We decided that all game income generated in Russia in the last 2 months will be donated to help Ukrainian refugees fleeing the war.[/b]

Thus believing that if we stay together, Ukraine will survive and overcome.

[i]sincerely, LUXO Interactive[/i][/quote]

notes.title: Cyber Attack is now available.
notes.content:
Cyber Attack is now available on Steam!

Cyber Attack gives the opportunity to take control of your own, global team of hackers. Intercept corporations, governments, and criminals all over the world.
At this game, you can be a protector of humanity by taking over private messages of dangerous people or try to get rich by helping corporations.
This is only your decision!

Cyber Attack is a strategy game with economic elements.
You have the ability to hack different kinds of devices in over 7000 cities but be careful! Every decision has own consequences! Attacks on corporations will bring a lot of money but your group will be more recognizable and easier to track.

Corrupted politicians can hire other hidden organizations
to hack and destroy your group! Boss of hackers cannot sleep well when criminals want to find him! In Cyber Attack your fame could be dangerous so you have to act carefully.

Who knows what the next day
will bring? Money or shame?
